text:
alex: Heads-up — I pushed a draft of the release notes for the beta rollout into PR #412. Pls skim for accuracy and any API example breakage before EOD.

maria: On it. Quick question: did we include the note about the embedding streaming deprecation edge-case? I spotted one customer repro that only happens with 2-token prefixes.

jin: I saw that too — the relnotes draft mentions deprecation but not the repro steps. We should add a tiny troubleshooting blurb and link to the internal ticket.

sam: Also the Go SDK snippet in the draft doesn't compile for me: missing ctx import + fmt. I can send a patched snippet.

alex: @sam please paste the minimal fix here. We want runnable snippets in the docs.

sam: Patch: ```go
package main
import (
  \"context\"
  \"fmt\"
)
// ...rest of example...
```
This is the minimal change. I also tightened the example output to match current API.

maria: For localization: French and German l10n teams called out the phrasing around \"fallback routing\" being ambiguous. Suggest we add a one-line glossary entry and update sentence to avoid idioms.

alex: Good call. Jin, can you add the glossary entry and a short note under \"Known issues\"? Keep it one sentence.

jin: Done in the draft. I also added a short troubleshooting step for the 2-token embedding repro: \"If your prefix is <=2 tokens and you see tokenization mismatch, try forcing tokenizer v2 or use the legacy-compat model variant.\"

maria: Nice. Small nit: link URL for the internal ticket is a private link; for the public docs we should reference the KB short-id instead (KB-4589). I'll swap before merge.

alex: Good. Two more items: 1) Add a changelog bullet about the new batching heuristic (customer-facing); 2) Note the planned rollout window (May 2–3) and the rollback policy.

sam: For the changelog bullet, I drafted: \"Improved request batching heuristic to reduce per-token latency for short-chat workloads (opt-in via batching.policy=adaptive).\" Thoughts?

maria: Suggest reword: \"opt-in\" -> \"available via\" to avoid confusion about default.

sam: Updated: \"available via batching.policy=adaptive\".

jin: I ran snippet linter locally. One more tiny lint: JSON example has trailing comma on last property. I'll fix and push.

alex: Thanks. Last check: @docs-bot can you run the snippet verification + link-check on the PR branch? Prefer to get green CI before merging.

docs-bot: Running snippet-verify and linkcheck on refs/heads/release/beta-relnotes-412.
docs-bot: snippet-verify: 3 warnings (non-blocking) — fixed by jin/sam in latest commits. linkcheck: 2 broken external links (404).

maria: I replaced one 404 with an archived redirect. The other is an external tutorial we referenced; I replaced with an official spec link.

alex: Great. Plan: merge after CI passes + small editorial pass tomorrow morning. If anything else pops up, leave comments on PR #412 and we'll triage. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll post the example smoke test command in PR comments.

jin: Also noted: add a short \"What to watch for post-rollout\" section with the three telemetry alerts we'll be monitoring.

alex: Perfect. Thanks everyone.
